crossRefs.note: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

people.name: Hermon_Mount
people.line: Mountain on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
translations.bsb: Does the snow of Lebanon ever leave its rocky slopes? Or do its cool waters flowing from a distance ever run dry?
translations.kjv: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
translations.asv: Shall the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? or shall the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?
